source.title: The maturing architecture of the brain's default network
source.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

confidence_rationale: This is the developmental-trajectory half ARC-090 needs: using resting-state functional connectivity MRI, the default network is shown to be only SPARSELY connected in school-age children (7-9 yrs) and to INTEGRATE into a cohesive, interconnected network over development into adulthood. That the internal DMN is not present as a mature system early but assembles over development is direct support for ARC-090's framing of the internal DMN as a developmental END-STATE rather than an innate given. Confidence held below 0.8 because the data show the network MATURES; they do not show WHAT drives the maturation, and in particular do not establish that external play / self-narration is the precursor that compresses inward -- ARC-090's specific causal mechanism is beyond what connectivity maturation alone demonstrates.
failure_signatures: The study shows DMN connectivity INTEGRATES with age but is agnostic about cause -- it does not show that externalised play/private-speech experience is what drives the integration, so it supports 'the internal DMN is a developmental end-state' but NOT 'externalisation is the route to it' (ARC-090's distinctive causal thesis).

Resting-state functional connectivity maturation is a network-architecture measure, not a functional measure of when self-reference / future-simulation capacities come online behaviourally -- the inference from 'sparse connectivity at 7-9' to 'these mental functions are not yet internalised' is an additional step.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Resting-state functional connectivity MRI shows the brain's default network is only sparsely functionally connected at early school age (7-9 years); over development these regions integrate into a cohesive, strongly interconnected network. The mature 'default mode' architecture studied in adults is therefore a developmental achievement, not a fixed early-present system.
mapping.ree_translation: Direct support for the DEVELOPMENTAL half of ARC-090: the internal DMN is an END-STATE that assembles over development, consistent with ARC-090's claim that the internal generative-modelling system is reached over a developmental ladder rather than being innate. Pairs with the Andrews-Hanna 2011 entry (which grounds WHAT the mature DMN does) to cover both halves: the function set and the fact that it matures.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The study demonstrates that the network matures and integrates with age; it is silent on the CAUSE of maturation and specifically does not show that externalised play or self-narration is the precursor that compresses inward. ARC-090's distinctive externalise->internalise causal mechanism is not tested here -- only its prerequisite (the internal DMN is developmentally assembled).
mapping.source_context: Human developmental neuroimaging; resting-state fcMRI across children, adolescents, and adults.

confidence_components.notes: Landmark, high-citation PNAS developmental fcMRI study; source quality high. Mapping fidelity moderate -- it grounds that the internal DMN is developmentally assembled (the prerequisite for ARC-090) but not the externalisation cause. Transfer risk low-moderate: human developmental data -> REE's developmental-end-state framing, with the causal-mechanism gap as the main caveat.
